The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''25,802 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as the year '''10,651 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]]. That year, the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Lanoree Brock]] and [[Dalien Brock]] set out on their [[Great Journey]] across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], though their Journey ended with Dalien fleeing into the depths of the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]] and being presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
